Keywords.Sturdy: When units where all models have this rule are shot or charged from over 9" away, they get +1 to defense rolls.
Keywords.Fortified: When units where all models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).
Keywords.Melee Slayer: When this model charges, its weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(3) or higher.
Keywords.Infiltrate: Counts as having Ambush, but may be deployed anywhere over 3” away from enemy unit.
Keywords.Shred: On unmodified results of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.
Keywords.Slow: This model moves 4" on Advance and 8" on Rush/Charge.

Army Spells.Rune of Battle (1): Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Rapid Charge once (next time the effect would apply).
Army Spells.Rune of Breaking (1): Pick one enemy model within 18", which takes 2 hits with AP(1). This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1].
Army Spells.Rune of Protection (2): Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Sturdy Boost once (next time the effect would apply).
Army Spells.Rune of Cleaving (2): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 4 hits with AP(1) and Shred.
Army Spells.Rune of Spite (3): Pick up to three enemy units within 18", which moves -2" when using Advance actions and -4" when using Rush/Charge actions once.
Army Spells.Rune of Smiting (3): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which takes 3 hits with Blast(3).
